info.name: Azure REST Virtual Machines API
Virtual Machines
Azure Virtual Machines List virtual machines in a resource group

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Client API version.

params.name: $filter
params.description: The system query option to filter VMs returned in the response. Allowed value is 'virtualMachineScaleSet/id' eq /subscriptions/{subId}/resourceGroups/{rgName}/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSets/{vmssName}'.

params.name: $expand
params.description: The expand expression to apply on the operation. 'instanceView' retrieves a snapshot of the runtime properties of the virtual machine that is managed by the platform and can change outside of control plane operations.

items.docs: Lists all of the virtual machines in the specified resource group. Use the nextLink property in the response to get the next page of virtual machines.
